definitions.explanation: An organized group of people who share a common interest, especially extracurricular activity clubs at schools.
An entertainment venue for dancing and nightlife.

examples.japanese: ⟦テニス→テニス：01784_tenisu⟧クラブ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧クラブ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{三|さん}{回|かい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: School club activities are three times a week.

examples.english: To go clubbing on the weekend.
Clubs in Shibuya get packed on Friday nights.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 (club/organization) is the most common usage. In Japanese schools, クラブ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ or ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧ refers to extracurricular clubs, which play a central role in student life. クラブ is more common in elementary and some junior high schools, while ⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧ is standard in junior high and high school.

Sense 2 (nightclub) is context-dependent and usually clear from the situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クラブ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: club activities
- ゴルフクラブ: golf club (organization or equipment)
- クラブ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join a club
- ⟦{会員制|かいいんせい}→会員制：16796_kaiinsei⟧クラブ: members-only club
